title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Environmental Sensors - EnvironmentalObservation
description: An observation of an environmental property made by an environmental sensor (edintmed:EnvironmentalObservation, subclass of sosa:Observation).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EnvironmentalObservation'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

madeBySensor.description: Relationship. The EnvironmentalSensor that made this observation (sosa:madeBySensor).

featureOfInterest.description: Relationship. The entity or environmental medium whose quality was observed, e.g. Air, Water, Soil (sosa:hasFeatureOfInterest). Kept as an open Relationship to a SKOS concept URI, consistent with this candidate's other Observation entities, even though the source's own FeatureOfInterest scheme is small (13 concepts).

observedProperty.description: Relationship. The environmental property that was observed, e.g. NO2 concentration (sosa:observedProperty). Kept as an open Relationship to a SKOS concept URI; see EnvironmentalSensor.observableProperty for why this isn't a fixed enum.

result.description: Property. The simple value of the observation (sosa:hasSimpleResult).

unitCode.description: Property. The unit the result is expressed in, from QUDT's unit vocabulary (qudt:unit), e.g. 'MicroGM-PER-M3'. The source models this as a Relationship to a qudt:Unit resource; kept here as the unit's own code/local name, matching this candidate's simpler numeric-result-plus-unit convention.

resultTime.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Instant when the observation result was generated (sosa:resultTime).

phenomenonTime.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Instant or interval when the observed situation occurred (sosa:phenomenonTime).
